scenes.text: Meet Tuna Eye. Your AI-assisted tuna quality grading kiosk.
Start by identifying the expert grader handling the session.
Choose sashibo core, tail-cut, or both. Then identify whether samples belong to the same fish.
Follow the sample placement guide, then enter the tuna's measured weight.
Capture or upload the sashibo-core image, review it, and confirm before analysis.
Tuna Eye sends the image to Raspberry Pi for analysis, then displays a grade recommendation with confidence.
Repeat the process for tail-cut. Each sample receives its own grading result.
Expert graders can review or override recommendations, with their decisions reflected in the grading record.
Review the grading summary, prepare a printable receipt, and complete the session.
Completed results remain available in local records, with synchronization supported when configured.
Tuna Eye. Sea Beyond the Cut.
